name: Candlelight: Queen vs. The Beatles
description: A string quartet plays songs by Queen and The Beatles by candlelight at Palácio da Bolsa on 31 October at 22:00. Tickets from €18.50.
longDescription:
Candlelight concerts are live performances held in a space lit by candles. This one is a tribute concert: a string quartet plays the music of Queen and The Beatles. It has no affiliation with the artists.

The planned programme includes Here Comes the Sun, Blackbird, Come Together, Yesterday and All You Need Is Love by The Beatles, and Love of My Life, Another One Bites the Dust, We Will Rock You, Radio Ga-Ga and Bohemian Rhapsody by Queen. The concert lasts 60 minutes.

The concert is at Palácio da Bolsa on Saturday 31 October 2026 at 22:00. Doors open 60 minutes before the start, and you can't get in once it begins. Seats are given out on arrival, first come first served, based on your ticket type. It's open to ages 8 and up, and under-16s must come with an adult. The venue is accessible for people with reduced mobility. Tickets from €18.50.

O programa planeado inclui Here Comes the Sun, Blackbird, Come Together, Yesterday e All You Need Is Love dos The Beatles, e Love of My Life, Another One Bites the Dust, We Will Rock You, Radio Ga-Ga e Bohemian Rhapsody dos Queen. O concerto dura 60 minutos.

O concerto é no Palácio da Bolsa no sábado, 31 de outubro de 2026, às 22:00. As portas abrem 60 minutos antes do início, e não é possível entrar depois de começar. Os lugares são atribuídos à chegada, por ordem de chegada, com base no tipo de bilhete. É aberto a maiores de 8 anos, e os menores de 16 anos devem vir acompanhados por um adulto.
